walls.note: Kortrijk: Burgundian wall (1354-1454, 5 gates, 26 towers) including Overleie north of the Leie, bastioned between 1577 and 1648 (completed by the French in 1646-48, who also built a pentagonal citadel on the east flank of Overbeke, 1647-84; the town was Spanish again from 1648). Traced from the Ferraris map (1777) along the main rampart; the citadel is a landmark point only (not on Ferraris).

landmarks.y1650: Belfry on the Grote Markt (14th c.), once part of the cloth hall; on the UNESCO list.
Main parish church, its tower the town's main bell tower.
Collegiate church by the counts' castle; Van Dyck's Raising of the Cross (1631) hangs here. The golden spurs of 1302 hung here until the French took them in 1382.
Two towers guarding the Leie bridge (1385 and 1411-13).
Pentagonal citadel built by the French in 1646-48 on the east flank of Overbeke, held by Spain from 1648, razed 1684; position approximate.
